_comment: Project catalog: the reusable inventory and declarations to assemble a Camunda 7 process from. This JSON is the CANONICAL form, but the skill also accepts the catalog inline in the prompt / as YAML / as a Markdown table and normalizes it to this shape (and can infer it from the repo when none is given). Reuse the exact names everywhere. Wire what exists; stub activities/forms/decisions that don't (+ spec). conventions = the project defaults the skill follows.

conventions.asyncDefault: asyncBefore on external/long tasks and before wait states
conventions.naming: node ids PascalCase, external topics kebab-case, delegate beans camelCase

activities.name: Compute credit score
activities.description: Calls the credit bureau and returns a 0-1000 score.

messages.name: PaymentReceived
messages.description: Bank confirms payment (correlate by this name).

decisions.name: Risk decision
decisions.description: DMN table mapping amount -> risk band.
